questionEn: Which formulation more accurately separates “burning” from similar ideas?
questionUz: Qaysi formula "yonish" ni o'xshash g'oyalardan aniqroq ajratib turadi?
choicesEn: Combustion is the process of reaction of substances with oxygen, which occurs with the release of heat and light. Oxide is binary.
A complex substance of two elements, one of which is oxygen
choicesUz: Yonish - bu issiqlik va yorug'lik chiqishi bilan sodir bo'ladigan moddalarning kislorod bilan reaksiyaga kirishish jarayoni. Oksid ikkilikdir.
Ikki elementdan iborat murakkab modda, ulardan biri kislorod
explanationEn: Combustion is the process of reaction of substances with oxygen, which occurs with the release of heat and light. Oxide is a binary compound, one element of which is oxygen.
explanationUz: Yonish - bu issiqlik va yorug'lik chiqishi bilan sodir bo'ladigan moddalarning kislorod bilan reaksiyaga kirishish jarayoni. Oksid ikkilik birikma bo'lib, uning bir elementi kisloroddir.
